title: In Memory of My Wife, Elise Cawley, with Thanks for 36 Wonderful Years
summary: Stephen Wolfram publishes a heartfelt memorial for his wife Elise Cawley who passed away in 2026, reflecting on their 36-year marriage and expressing gratitude for their time together.
problem_solved: This is not a technical article—it is a personal memorial post expressing grief and appreciation for a loved one.
why_valuable: The post received 1377 points and 80 comments on Hacker News, demonstrating that personal human stories resonate with audiences even in tech communities, offering a moment of shared empathy.
